JSON Formatter

Format, validate, and minify JSON with error highlighting.

Developer
—

🔒 100% client-side — your data never leaves your browser

How to Use

  1. 1Paste or type your JSON into the input area.
  2. 2The formatter instantly validates whether your JSON is syntactically correct.
  3. 3If valid, the output shows properly indented JSON with syntax highlighting.
  4. 4Use the minify button to compress the JSON to a single line.
  5. 5Use the copy button to copy the result to your clipboard.

FAQ

Does this send my JSON to a server?
No. All processing happens entirely in your browser using JavaScript. Nothing is transmitted, stored, or logged.
What happens if my JSON has errors?
The formatter highlights the line and character position of the error, making it easy to spot and fix typos.
Can I format already-minified JSON?
Yes. Paste any minified or compact JSON and it will be formatted with proper indentation immediately.
